admission.justification: Two designs were weighed against each other - a log of requests and a log of effects - and the choice decides what every later reader of the log may infer from a missing row.

alternatives.option: Record every worktree_start call, dry run included, in the observer log
alternatives.reason: The log is the record of what agents asked; a preview is something an agent asked, and a gap in the record is indistinguishable from a call that was never made.

alternatives.option: Skip the log entry for a dry run, so a preview leaves no trace
alternatives.reason: It would make the log a record of effects rather than of requests, and a reader could no longer tell a preview from silence.
alternatives.reconsider_when: a caller needs a preview indistinguishable from a call that never happened, for example a conformance proof that a preview has no effect and cannot tolerate a log line.

consequences: The worktree_start description states both sentences: the dry run changes nothing, and the call is logged.
context: A worktree_start dry run changes no task document, no contract, no Git ref and no worktree, yet the observer log records every tool call. The packet had to say whether a preview is itself a call for the log's purposes.
decider: the developer, under D47, as MIK-R83@v1 rule 8 states it
